title: Programming in Python: Lists, Loops, Functions
subject: computing

sections.body: Python is a popular text-based language. print("Hello") shows Hello on the screen.
A LIST stores many values: scores = [7, 9, 4]. A FOR loop repeats for each item: for s in scores: print(s).
A FUNCTION is a named block of code you can reuse: def double(n): return n * 2. Then double(5) gives 10.
Use a free online Python editor to write a function that adds up a list of numbers.

quiz.q: What does this print? for n in [1, 2, 3]: print(n * 10)
hints: The loop runs once for each item.
Each time, it prints n multiplied by 10.
for x in [2, 4]: print(x + 1) prints 3, then 5.
quiz.explain: It prints 10, 20 and 30, one per line.

quiz.q: Given def square(x): return x * x, what is square(4)?
hints: If def triple(x): return x * 3, then triple(5) = 15.
